disclaimer: Method and tooling evidence. Synthetic fixtures demonstrate the tooling, not DFT/MLIP accuracy or physical transport. No restricted campaign numbers are shown.

cards.title: Reference-protocol checking
cards.question: Are the DFT references for training and validation actually compatible?
cards.contribution: Extracts CP2K protocol parameters (functional, dispersion, basis/pseudos, density-grid cutoffs, metallic-SCF smearing, charge, periodicity, stress request) and flags any material training-vs-validation mismatch before a model error is interpreted.
cards.data_origin: Real CP2K input template (protocol parameters only) + synthetic comparison fixture
cards.what_was_executed: summarize_reference_protocol + compare_reference_protocols; parsed a real CP2K template; unit tests pass
cards.limitation: A two-cutoff check does not establish convergence of every property; basis/grid/SCF convergence are distinct.
cards.next_step: Attach a force-convergence-ladder summary on matched geometries.

cards.title: Error-aware, per-species validation
cards.question: Does the model hide a weak channel behind a good average?
cards.contribution: Per-species force metrics with two explicit RMSE definitions, vector p95/max, per-frame breakdown, missing-species-as-missing-evidence, plus group-aware bootstrap CIs and a leakage/duplicate check. Demonstrates that a weak minority channel stays visible despite a low aggregate metric.
cards.data_origin: Synthetic multi-species fixture with an intentionally weak channel
cards.what_was_executed: force_metrics + estimate_metric_interval + detect_duplicate_frames on synthetic data; figures rendered with synthetic disclaimer; unit tests pass
cards.limitation: Synthetic demonstration; real per-element results are private. A single uncertainty-error correlation is not full calibration.
cards.next_step: Apply to a cleared, larger holdout with independent replicas for real CIs.

cards.title: Computational decision prototype
cards.question: Given the evidence, what is the right next computational action?
cards.contribution: A transparent, rules-based workflow-controller that maps explicit evidence + declared thresholds to one action (review reference, check mapping, request targeted labels, request more sampling, review scope, stop-in-scope, or insufficient evidence), with reasons, missing evidence, policy version, and provenance. Refuses out-of-scope deployments; never lets a score override missing physics.
cards.what_was_executed: recommend_next_action over synthetic evidence; unit tests cover missing-evidence, E-field refusal, scoped-repair, and stop-in-scope paths
cards.limitation: Fixed rule dispatcher, not a learned or autonomous scientist; launches nothing; no cost/time-savings claim.
cards.next_step: Benchmark a learned action selector against this baseline before any autonomy claim.
